name: Watch a page
tagline: Tells you when a price drops, something is back in stock or a slot opens up.
summary: Watch a web page on a schedule and tell the user only when what they care about changes: a price, stock, a new post, an appointment slot. Each watch keeps what it last saw in files/watches/ and ends when it has found what it was for.
can: Check a page on a schedule, signed in or not, and remember what it saw
Tell you only when what you asked about changes, with the old and new values
Stop by itself once it has found what it was for, or on a date you choose
